//: Test files only, and separate from the app config on purpose.
`src/**/*.test.ts` runs under `tsx --test`, so it needs node:test,
node:assert and the rest of the Node globals. Adding `types: [node]`
to the APP config would have been one line shorter and wrong: it
injects Buffer, setImmediate and friends into every screen, so a
mistake that crashes on a device would typecheck cleanly here.
The app config excludes these files; this one is the only place they
are checked, and `npm run typecheck:test` is in the standard bar.
